<structure>
    <realm>Client</realm>
    <description>Table structure used by <page>matproxy.Add</page>.</description>
    <fields>
<item name="name" type="string">The name of the material proxy</item>
<item name="init" type="function">The function used to get variables from the ".vmt". Called once per each ".vmt".

<callback>
<arg type="table" name="self">The table structure itself</arg>
<arg type="IMaterial" name="mat">The material.</arg>
<arg type="table" name="values">The material key values</arg>
</callback>
</item>
<item name="bind" type="function">The function used to apply the proxy. This is called every frame while any materials with this proxy are used in world.

<callback>
<arg type="table" name="self">The table structure itself.</arg>
<arg type="IMaterial" name="mat">The material.</arg>
<arg type="Entity" name="ent">The entity the material instance is applied to, if any.</arg>
</callback>
</item>
    </fields>

</structure>
